instruction: Joyful outdoor snapshot, medium shot from a low angle. On a sunny city street with green trees, the man in a patterned shirt (R2) gives a piggyback ride to the woman in a striped t-shirt (R1). She laughs joyfully with her mouth open, holding onto his back, while he smiles brightly, carrying her forward. Bright daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the vibrant green foliage in the background.
